params.name: currentStep
params.description: Required with totalSteps for step-based progress. Base step value, clamped between 1 and the normalized total. The overall step value includes subSegmentProgress / 100 and is capped at the total. Step options take precedence over percentage options; generated page text rounds the overall step value up.

params.name: totalSteps
params.description: Required with currentStep for step-based progress. The number of segments, rounded to an integer with a minimum of 1.

params.name: progressState
params.description: Required for percentage mode when the step options are not both supplied. Base progress percentage, clamped between 1 and 100. With subSegmentProgress at 0, this is the overall percentage used for both visual fill and ARIA, matching React.

params.name: totalSegments
params.description: Required with progressState for percentage mode. The fixed number of segments, rounded to an integer with a minimum of 1.

params.name: subSegmentProgress
params.description: Additional progress as a percentage of one segment, clamped between 0 and 100. Adds subSegmentProgress / segmentCount to percentage progress, or subSegmentProgress / 100 to step progress. Defaults to 0; the overall value is capped at completion and determines both fill and ARIA.

params.name: label
params.description: Optional text shown on the left of the header, above the track. The accessible name remains Progress Bar.

params.name: progressText
params.description: Optional free-form text shown on the right of the header in percentage mode. Keep it consistent with overall progress; it does not override calculated ARIA values. Step mode generates Page X of Y instead.

params.name: helperText
params.description: Optional supporting text below the track. Read separately from the progress bar by assistive technology.

params.name: showBars
params.description: Whether to show gaps between segments. Defaults to true. Set to false for a continuous track without gaps.

params.name: classes
params.description: Additional CSS classes for the outer element, merged with ofh-progress-indicator.

params.name: attributes
params.description: Additional HTML attributes, such as id or data attributes, for the outer element.
